caption: The drawing depicts a mechanical figurine group mounted on a rectangular base. The figures are three individuals engaged in a baseball scene. On the left side, a figure in a red shirt, blue pants, and light brown shoes is crouching, wearing a catcher's mask and mitt. In the center, a batter is shown mid-swing, wearing a blue shirt with white stripes, yellow pants, blue socks with yellow stripes, brown shoes, and a white cap with blue markings. To the right, a third figure stands leaning forward with their hands on their knees, dressed in a red shirt, blue pants, red socks, brown shoes, and a yellow and white cap. The base beneath the figures is brown and green, with visible mechanical components and levers illustrated in red and yellow. There is a signature "CHARL MAKERNO" at the bottom right of the drawing. The background is a plain beige color.
title: Toy Bank
